_comment: Requirement analysis handoff for ANALYSE: pipeline. Final instance: epics/<EPIC-KEY>/<EPIC-KEY>-analysis.json. Pair with <KEY>-analysis.md. Do not reference epics/<KEY>/temp/ in durable JSON. May append Known issue > lines to sibling -coverage.json/-coverage.md when coverage loaded and reconciliation verdict is in_scope_relevant.

sources.note: ref_loaded/coverage_loaded: true only when file was read successfully for this run.

_summary.text: 1–4 sentences: what we test and why (practical).

_gaps_item.type: unverifiable | snippet_missing | ambiguity | client_shell_unknown | grounding | other
_gaps_item.evidence: Optional pointer, e.g. requirements[].key CRT-123 snippet_status=missing, or checks[].id chk-002

_questions_item.dimension: testability | completeness | consistency | cross_surface | operational | other
_questions_item.evidence: Quote or artifact path when kind=grounded; null when hypothesis
